seo_title: NCLT Kolkata Sanctions Warren Tea-Maple Hotels Merger
title: NCLT Kolkata Sanctions Amalgamation of Warren Tea Limited Into Maple Hotels & Resorts Limited
case_name: In re: Scheme of Amalgamation of Warren Tea Limited with Maple Hotels & Resorts Limited
citation: Company Petition (CAA) No. 66/KB/2026; order dated 5 November 2026
card_summary: The Kolkata Bench of the NCLT sanctioned the amalgamation of Warren Tea Limited into Maple Hotels & Resorts Limited after shareholders approved the scheme at a tribunal-convened meeting. Each Warren Tea shareholder gets one Maple Hotels share of the same face value, and Maple Hotels takes on Warren Tea's assets and liabilities. The scheme takes effect only once the order is filed with the Registrar of Companies.
card_tip: An NCLT order sanctioning a merger scheme is not the final step; the scheme takes legal effect only once the certified order is filed with the Registrar of Companies.
verification_notes: The 5 November 2026 sanction date, the case number (CAA No. 66/KB/2026), the share-exchange ratio and the pending ROC filing are reported consistently by two independent sources, Investywise and Multibagg. One unrelated report referred to a 30 September 2026 date for what appears to be a different procedural step in the same matter; that date conflicts with the sanction date given by the two sources relied on here and is not used.
